intro:
Some women come with a warning. 
You've never been good at listening.
description:
Criminal Hearts puts you on rooftops at 3am, in back rooms where deals go sideways, and across the table from three women who should scare you.

They don't.

One of them doesn't talk. One of them talks too much. One tells you exactly what she is and dares you to stay anyway.

Every line you choose either pulls her closer or shuts the door for good. Your companion has your back and tells you the truth, but the risk is yours to take.

Say the right thing and she lets something slip she's never told anyone. Push too hard and she's gone before you can fix it.

Three women. Three ways this ends. None of them planned on you.


Features:

● ONE WRONG WORD CHANGES EVERYTHING: Trust here is earned slowly and lost instantly.

● THREE WOMEN WORTH THE RISK: Each one guards something different, and none of them hand it over.

● DARK ROMANCE VISUAL NOVEL: Cinematic, heavy, and built on choices that stick.

● MULTIPLE ENDINGS: Redemption, ruin, or something a lot closer to obsession.

● A COMPANION IN YOUR CORNER: Reads the room, calls you out, never lies to you.


Three women nobody has ever gotten close to.
You're not here to be careful.
Get close.
